description: Preeti Studio Driving Motion Library for SCAIL-2 Controlled Performance Transfer

motions.name: Idle Listen
motions.description: Natural head nods, subtle weight shift, listening attentively with occasional micro-blinks and breathing motion.

motions.name: Talking Calm
motions.description: Measured conversational gestures, slight hand cadence, relaxed posture, casual articulation.

motions.name: Talking Angry
motions.description: Aggressive emphasis, sharp hand movements, tense jaw, forward head thrust on key syllable accents.

motions.name: Stand Up
motions.description: Transition from seated position to standing upright, hands pushing off chair/thighs, body alignment.

motions.name: Sit Down
motions.description: Controlled descent into chair/seat, weight transfer, hands adjusting coat/knees on settling.

motions.name: Walk In
motions.description: Approaches camera from off-screen left/right into mid-ground mark, decelerates and comes to a stop.

motions.name: Turn Away
motions.description: Pivots 180 degrees away from subject/camera, shoulders drop or tense, showing back profile.

motions.name: Point
motions.description: Right arm extends forward, index finger points authoritatively at object or off-screen subject.

motions.name: Look At Phone
motions.description: Raises mobile phone into view, eyes scan display screen, thumbs tap briefly, eyebrows raise.

motions.name: Hand Object
motions.description: Extends arm holding prop/item forward for recipient to take, waits for grip, releases hand.

motions.name: Shocked Step Back
motions.description: Sudden recoil, takes half-step back, hands raise defensively to chest height, eyes widen in shock.
